comment: Shared Tailwind v4 theme layer for the Griffel to Tailwind CSS + CSS Modules migration: the fui cascade-layer order, the @custom-variant catalog, the base-scale spacing bridge and the generated Fluent token registration. New package. Converted component packages ship plain CSS that references theme-level custom properties, so consumers import @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme/styles.css exactly once at their document root; see the package README.
